title: 8.10.2: Key Equations
originalText:
Key Equations

            Law of Sines	
            \(\begin{matrix}\frac{sin α}{a}=\frac{sin β}{b}=\frac{sin γ}{c}\\\frac{a}{sin α}=\frac{b}{sin β}=\frac{c}{sin γ}\end{matrix}\)	

            Area for oblique triangles	
            \(\begin{matrix}Area=\frac{1}{2}bcsin α\\ =\frac{1}{2}acsin β\\ =\frac{1}{2}absin γ\end{matrix}\)	

            Law of Cosines	
            \(\begin{matrix}{a}^{2}={b}^{2}+{c}^{2}−2bccos α\\{b}^{2}={a}^{2}+{c}^{2}−2accos β\\{c}^{2}={a}^{2}+{b}^{2}−2abcos γ\end{matrix}\)	

            Heron’s formula	
            \(\begin{matrix}Area=\sqrt{s(s−a)(s−b)(s−c)}\\wheres=\frac{(a+b+c)}{2}\end{matrix}\)	

            Conversion formulas	
            \(\begin{matrix}&cos θ=\frac{x}{r}→x=rcos θ\\&sin θ=\frac{y}{r}→y=rsin θ\\&{r}^{2}={x}^{2}+{y}^{2}\\&tan θ=\frac{y}{x}\end{matrix}\)
